The diff replaces the placeholder with a complete implementation of `word_wrap`. The function normalizes whitespace using `split()`, greedily accumulates words into lines up to `width`, and joins them with newlines. This fully covers the task scope: greedy line wrapping, breaking only between words, handling arbitrary input whitespace, and leaving long words unbroken on their own lines.

The change takes the original tree (which contained a stub raising `NotImplementedError`) and replaces it with an O(N) pass that correctly handles empty inputs, single-word lines, and multiple spaces. It does exactly what was requested without introducing side effects or unnecessary complexity.
